## What's New — Video Editor
Imagitor is the first ever Urdu video editor. Edit videos with a full timeline — trim clips, add transitions and filters. Add animated Urdu text overlays, stickers, and background music from a free library. AI Slides turns a text prompt into a ready-made slideshow video.
